reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created from January to November 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
),
active_1 AS (  -- one row per cohort account with a usage week in month 1
  SELECT DISTINCT c.account_id
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN usage_weekly w ON w.account_id = c.account_id
  WHERE date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', w.week_start) AS DATE)) = 1
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(a.account_id) AS active_month_1
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN active_1 a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
GROUP BY c.cohort_month
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS cohort_accounts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.account_id) AS active_month_1
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN usage_weekly w
  ON w.account_id = a.account_id
 AND date_diff('month', CAST(a.created_at AS DATE), w.week_start) = 1
WHERE a.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND a.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usage_weekly w
                             WHERE w.account_id = a.account_id
                               AND date_diff('month', CAST(a.created_at AS DATE), w.week_start) = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_month_1
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND a.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1

                               AND date_diff('month', CAST(a.created_at AS DATE), w.week_start) = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_month_1

other_way.tradeoff: EXISTS asks once per account whether a week falls in month 1, so no account is counted twice, but it is longer to write.

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cm FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', week_start) AS DATE) AS wm FROM usage_weekly
)
SELECT c.cm AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts, COUNT(a.account_id) AS active_month_1
FROM c LEFT JOIN a ON a.account_id = c.account_id AND a.wm = CAST(c.cm + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1
